script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The passage says the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but does not say everything else in the book is built on it.
The verse contrasts the beginning of knowledge with what fools despise; it does not name two groups or say one group begins with fear of the LORD.
Telling the baker to reread the verse if they don't believe him sounds confrontational rather than patient.
The explanation reverses the relationships: the father gives instruction and the mother gives teaching; they do not receive them.
It supplies a reason the voice spells out the ambush that the text does not give.
Saying the line is heavy on purpose assigns an intention the text does not state.
The sinners' pitch openly includes violence, not only the shiny part. The explanation also supplies a reason for letting them finish their pitch that the text does not give.
Even as a guess, the explanation assigns a reason the voice quotes the sinners that the text does not give.
It explains the bird net as a trap anyone can see coming and says the sinners walk into it. The passage does not spell out that connection.
Saying the voice names what was behind it all assigns a motive to the sinners that the text does not state.
